summary: Tested account dropdown sorting in Operations page. All features working correctly: immediate sorting on selection, localStorage cache persistence, and fallback from cachedOperations.

✅ filteredAccounts (lines 561-620) correctly sorts by lastUsed DESC, then usage count DESC
✅ operationsForRanking (lines 513-515) correctly falls back to cachedOperations when API data unavailable

context_for_next_testing_agent: Account sorting feature is fully working. The implementation uses a local usage cache (localStorage key: operations:account-usage:v1) that is updated immediately when an account is selected or when an operation is saved. The sorting is based on lastUsed timestamp (most recent first) and usage count (most used first).
